notes: TBox contraction paired with biology-replace-0020: removes its original rule (every echinoderm lives in the sea). Derived: the revision's three inheritance questions, each stating a little-known member's membership in the prompt, so the removed rule is the only route to the answer (three species by name (a feather star, a brittle star, a sea star) and an application, what water an aquarium tank should hold).
